name: Creamy Garlic Chicken
instructions: Cut the chicken into medium-sized pieces.
Melt the butter in a pan.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until fully cooked.
Add cream, garam masala, salt and black pepper.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Mutton Pepper Fry
instructions: Marinate the mutton with turmeric and salt.
Cook the mutton until tender.
Heat oil in a pan.
Add onions and cook until golden.
Add ginger garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add coriander powder and black pepper.
Add the cooked mutton.
Fry until the masala coats the mutton.

name: Vegetable Pulao
instructions: Wash and soak the rice for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee in a pot.
Add cumin and sliced onion.
Cook until the onion becomes lightly golden.
Add carrot, beans and peas.
Add the drained rice.
Add water and salt.
Cover and cook until the rice is completely cooked.

name: Chocolate Banana Cake
instructions: Mash the bananas in a bowl.
Cream the butter and sugar together.
Add the eggs and vanilla extract.
Add the mashed bananas.
Mix in the flour, cocoa powder and baking powder.
Add the milk and mix until combined.
Pour the batter into a cake tin.
Bake until the cake is cooked through.
